modality_provenance.quote: Case 1 –  Chest X-Ray: two ill-defined parenchymal opacities in the left medium-lower lung. No pleural effusion.
Case 2 –  Chest X-Ray before intensive care admission: bilateral consolidations, mainly peripheral and in lower lung zones, also in right perihilar zone. No pleural effusion.
Case 2 –  Chest X-Ray during hospitalization: improvement of lung transparency
Case 2 –  Chest X-Ray before hospital discharge: remaining of thin atelectatic streaks in the left basal zone.
